description: Resorts whose season OPENING DATE is a specific day — answers "what opens today?", "opening this week", or "which resorts start their season on June 27?". Returns only resorts scheduled or confirmed to open on that date, NOT all currently-open resorts. Prefer over get_southern_hemisphere_report for opening-day questions. This tool is date-scoped, so it is the wrong shape for two neighbouring questions: for a RANKED retrospective ("which resorts opened earliest for the 2025-26 season, top 6 by verified opening date"), use get_insights with category=season_calendar; for historical norms ("which resort typically opens earliest each season"), use ask_snowdata. For a US HOLIDAY ("which resorts are open for Thanksgiving / Christmas / Presidents' Day", "is X usually open by Thanksgiving"), pass `holiday` instead of `date`: the result is every resort projected or confirmed open on or before that holiday, each with its record ("opened by Thanksgiving 9 of the last 10 seasons"), sorted by that rate.

country.description: Filter by country, e.g. Chile or New Zealand

date.description: Opening date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC). Ignored when `holiday` is set.

holiday.description: US holiday mode: every resort open ON OR BEFORE the holiday (not only those opening that day), with its history for that holiday. Holiday dates are computed (Thanksgiving = 4th Thursday of November).

year.description: Calendar year of the holiday, with `holiday`. Defaults to the next occurrence.

name: get_season_openings

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).
